milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near a torch (at spawn-relative [0, 2, 5]) and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. max_distance=16 allows detection from the corridor entrance; facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the torch.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target is the center of the nether brick slab floor deeper in the corridor (spawn-relative [0, -1, 12]). max_distance=8 forces the player to walk into the corridor past the entrance torches before this triggers, enforcing sequential discovery. facing_tolerance=180 (no facing requirement) since the slabs are underfoot and looking down shouldn't be required.

Uses inventory_has because mining a jack_o_lantern causes it to drop itself as an item which enters the player's inventory. This is the most reliable check for a mine task — having the item proves the block was successfully mined and picked up.
